Loader execution was isolated with fake folder_paths and loader to check category, resolved local path and propagation of safe_load=True without network, real weights or GPU; pinned load_torch_file does not branch on that argument.

knownGaps: No compatible MediaPipe weight file was present or downloaded, so state-dict compatibility and real inference were not tested.
The official blueprint model URL is mutable and has no digest; model provenance was not independently established.
The source loads detector variants with strict=False and does not inspect incompatible keys; failure behavior for malformed weights remains unexecuted.
